component.name: Terminal Rooster
component.summary: Project-based terminals for running coding agents side by side

description.p: Terminal Rooster organizes terminals by project in renamable, splittable sessions, so you can run Claude Code, Codex and Grok side by side and keep track of per-project tasks.
Everything is saved as it changes. After a restart or a crash, layouts, scrollback and each agent's own conversation come back exactly as they were.
